_doc: Pearl overworld graphics id -> Black 2 overworld object code, for every graphics_id used by an object_event in PearlB2 work/pearl/events/*.json (153 ids, 3160 objects; "count" = objects using the id, "clones" = of them with script 0xFFFF, i.e. copies of a neighbouring map's object). "code" = Black 2 object code for zone NPC "model" (a/1/2/6) and ActorNew: 0-376 people/objects, 0x1000+ Pokemon (a/2/0/8 species table; names in pokebw2 generated/obj_codes.txt), 0x2000+ 3D objects, 162-177 = WKOBJCODE00-0F (object code read from work 0x4020+n). "b2" = what the code is in Black 2, "b2_const" = its obj_codes.txt name. "stand_in": false = Black 2 has this person/role/species/object; true = it does not, the code is the closest look (repaint later). code null = no usable Black 2 actor (signs, doors: building props + BG events; berry soil). Pearl names: pokediamond include/constants/sprites.h (SPRITE_*, gaps filled from pokeplatinum generated/object_events_gfx.txt); the two lists number ids 0-209 identically (cross-check: 349 Pearl event files matched to Platinum event files by object positions; every used id agrees except a few Platinum story re-casts, e.g. Twinleaf 389: id 12 = POKEMON_BREEDER_F, 19 = COLLECTOR, 148 = BARRY). Black 2 identities: HoennB2 data/sprite_map.json, the trainer class names in obj_codes.txt, vanilla zone NPC use (scripts, zones), the PWT table a/2/4/7 (u16 x8 records: objCode at +2, type<<8|tournament at +6; Sinnoh tournament 9 = records 45-52 -> 277-284) and contact sheets of the vanilla sheets (HoennB2 converter/sprite_sheet.py with B2_FILES = PearlB2 external/pokebw2/extract/b2_us/files). Limit: <= 30 distinct codes per zone (HoennB2 notes/NPC_LIMIT.md); "zone_check" below. "back": "generated" = the sheet's back view and steps are copies of its front frame (patches/pearl_pwt_frames; the PWT leaders): a person standing still facing up turns to the nearest way the official frames show (pearl_events.fit_move; b2tools/frame_check.py checks every person's frames).
